name: Beer
siboNotes: Beer contains fructans from barley/wheat which can feed SIBO bacteria. Limit to 1 serving and avoid wheat beers during SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Choose lighter beers over dark or wheat beers for potentially lower FODMAP content
Drink with food to slow absorption and reduce digestive impact
Stay hydrated with water between alcoholic drinks
Avoid beers with added fruit flavors or high fructose corn syrup
alternatives: Gin with tonic water (check tonic ingredients)
Hard cider made with low-FODMAP fruits
